name: Should multigenerational homes have separate entrances?

mainEntity.name: Should multigenerational homes have separate entrances?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, private entrances for suites or ADUs provide independence, reduce daily traffic through main living areas, and allow caregivers or visitors discreet access.
